card.text: The brightest and closest yellow supergiant to the Solar System, 73 times the Sun's width.

sources.label: Souza et al. (2021), Astronomy & Astrophysics 654 A19

introduction.text: VLTI measured its disc at 7.18 milliarcseconds, which at 95 parsecs is 73.2 solar radii, with 7,661 K at its surface.

sources.label: Souza et al. (2021), Astronomy & Astrophysics 654 A19
